capabilities: render recipe notes as interactive recipe cards
split recipes into two columns or separate ingredients by step
cross out ingredients and highlight the current step
use recipe cards on phones and tablets
extras: Full usage documentation is hosted outside the README; recipes work as regular Markdown notes in any format.
problem: Obsidian shows recipes as plain Markdown, which is hard to read and follow on a screen while cooking.

relations.evidence: The Style Settings plugin will let you configure aspects of how the recipe card appears.
Beta versions can also be installed using BRAT.

summary: Renders recipe notes as interactive cooking cards with quantity scaling, checkable ingredients, and step highlighting.
